rules: Entry selects an activity instance. BUS, PRO, CRE, PORT and COM ask their activity context before intentions; hospitality asks its subtype. SHOP, APP and SPACE narrow through their concrete intent choices. Unknown activity uses the declared conservative filter. Proposed basics are shown once and adjusted at review.

Stable record key = activityId / purposePath / nodeId. A purposePath starts at the selected intent option. Only edges with scope=child append an option ID. Parent fingerprints are provenance, never part of identity. Shared project/contact records use project scope.

Active graph is reconstructed from roots and current selections after every commit. Traverse selected options in declared order, depth first, then their appendAfter nodes, node appendAfter and module tails. A node tail runs only after a confirmed positive selection. Unknown, decline and skip do not activate tails.

For each stable key keep all incoming support edges. Ask a reachable unanswered key once, regardless of the number of supports. Preserve answered records while any support remains. Remove unsupported records, derived proposals, queue entries and generated text. Keep historical transcript marked superseded. Parent edits do not erase a still-supported shared answer.

Multiselect stages values until Use these choices. Unknown, decline and exclusive information-only clear all other choices; a positive nonexclusive choice clears exclusives. An empty Use these choices is disabled. Single selections advance immediately. A multiselect with two or more choices produces one multiReply, never one bubble per item.

Use the declared visibility filter plus unknown/decline choices. Unknown subtype never unlocks irrelevant options. Adding another activity from review creates another activityId and preserves previous activities; replacing an activity clears its unsupported descendants. Neither action changes contact/shared project records.

Every answer has explicit kind and status. A confirmed request to choose a provider may also produce a separate openDecision with null value. Existing fact, future requirement, future customer field and unresolved dependency remain separate in the email.

Only active structured records enter the brief. Derived customer fields use their declared support predicate and stay proposed until review. Changes recompute them. Never infer a real customer event, address, guest count, policy or confirmed booking from requested form fields.

At most one contextual acknowledgment then one next question. No extra Continue for a single selection. Preserve host/visitor bubbles, cancellation tokens, keyboard-collapsed defaults and reduced-motion behavior. Skip waits when reduced motion is requested. Do not force scroll while the visitor reads earlier messages.

Help, review, close and resume suspend/restore the exact cursor, staged choices and draft. Deferred answers count as explored. Never replay an already-visible prompt on reopen/reload. Use same-tab storage with a truthful memory-only fallback if storage fails.

Name and email are required only before preparing the inquiry email. Optional typing is restricted to public URLs/service names, exact operating facts and one optional note. Never request credentials or actual customer/client private records.

The Build companion prepares a manual editable email to geodiametrics@gmail.com. Opening an email app proves neither send nor delivery. Preserve Copy draft and selectable full text. Never truncate the brief. Draft edits survive close; changed answers offer explicit Regenerate or Keep edited draft.

No selected requirement guarantees a provider integration, price, deadline or included ongoing service. Existing published commercial terms stay unchanged. A new runtime change needs fresh applicable AI-entry routing and qualification; this document is design only.
